name: Delta Dental Insurance Company / Delta Dental of California (individual plans)
notes: Researched from public deltadentalins.com pages only (no sign-in; the CIAM sign-in page renders by JavaScript, so its field labels were not observed). Member FAQ: individual-plan premiums are paid directly to Delta Dental online or by check; online, sign in and choose 'Pay my bill' for a one-time payment by bank account, debit or credit card; 'Set up autopay' and 'Manage autopay' (update or cancel); autopay frequency depends on the plan (monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual). Paperless delivers claim statements, estimates and plan documents online with an email alert, and paperless bill holders get an email when a bill is ready. Accounts are created after the enrollment confirmation with the enrollee/member ID ('Create an account', then 'Enrollee/Adult Dependent'), modelled as a registration field accountNumber. Cancellation is not described as self-service: members contact Delta Dental and the policy documents hold the terms, so cancel_service is unsupported online with Customer Care's phone. Fees, grace periods, MFA and the sign-in identifier are not published and keep family defaults. Dashboard and payment-history labels in the account nav are generic (synthetic). Review 2026-10-09: the rendered sign-in page (Log In) asks for a Username alone first, with Create an account and Forgot username? links, so auth is identifier username in two steps (observed_public); the member-ID registration field comes from the member FAQ. Public nav added. Contact phone set to the published member/billing line so the footer no longer mixes in unrelated catalog numbers.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check to the remittance address on your bill.

cancel_service.note: To cancel your individual plan, contact Delta Dental Customer Care at 888-282-9501. Cancellation terms are in your Policy and Benefit Details or Evidence of Coverage.

help.title: Pay your individual plan premium
paragraphs: If you bought your dental plan yourself, you pay Delta Dental directly, either online or by check.
To pay online, log in and choose Pay my bill. A one-time payment can come from a bank account, a debit card or a credit card.
If you have chosen paperless bills you get an email when a new bill is ready; otherwise your bill comes in the mail.
steps: Log in to your online account.
Enter the amount and pick a bank account, debit card or credit card.

help.title: Set up or manage autopay
paragraphs: Log in and choose Set up autopay to have your premium paid automatically from a bank account, debit card or credit card. You can also set it up when you enroll.
How often autopay runs depends on your plan: it may be monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual.
To change or stop automatic payments later, choose Manage autopay.
steps: Log in to your online account.
Choose Set up autopay (or Manage autopay to change or cancel it).
Pick your payment method and confirm.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: With paperless delivery your claim statements, pre-treatment estimates and plan documents are posted to your online account, and you get an email each time a new document arrives.
If you have not gone paperless, your bills and documents come by mail.

help.title: Create your online account
paragraphs: Wait for your enrollment confirmation, which includes your enrollee or member ID. Then go to the log in page, choose Create an account, pick Enrollee/Adult Dependent from the list and follow the prompts.
The site works in a mobile browser, so there is no app to download.

help.title: Cancel your plan
paragraphs: Plans are not cancelled online. Contact Delta Dental Customer Care at 888-282-9501 (TTY 711), Monday to Friday 8am to 9pm Eastern.
Your Policy and Benefit Details or Evidence of Coverage explains the cancellation terms for your plan.

help.title: Contact Customer Care
paragraphs: Delta Dental Customer Care: 888-282-9501 (TTY 711), Monday to Friday 8am to 9pm Eastern. Mail: P.O. Box 1803, Alpharetta, GA 30023.
Premiums can be paid by credit card, check or electronic funds transfer, and most people pay monthly; depending on the plan you may also pay quarterly, twice a year or once a year.

extra.intent: Using the Delta Dental help pages, find how often autopay can run for an individual dental plan. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Depending on the plan, autopay can be monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual.
